from pydantic import TypeAdapter
from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls, ToolCalls as TC

TC_ = ToolCalls

# --- Task 1: validate_input return shapes ---
d = {"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}
assert TC_.validate_input(d) == d

s = {"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}
assert TC_.validate_input(s) == s

l = [{"name": "foo", "args": {}}, {"name": "bar", "args": {}}]
assert TC_.validate_input(l) == l

assert TC_.validate_input('{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}') == {"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}
assert TC_.validate_input('[{"name": "foo", "args": {}}]') == [{"name": "foo", "args": {}}]
assert TC_.validate_input('{"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {}}]}') == {"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {}}]}
assert TC_.validate_input("not a json string") == "not a json string"

# --- Task 1: construction from all formats ---
t1 = TC_(tool_calls=[TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"a": 1})])
t2 = TC_(**{"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]})
t3 = TC_.model_validate({"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}})
t4 = TC_.model_validate([{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}, {"name": "bar", "args": {}}])
t5 = TC_.model_validate('{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}')
t6 = TC_.model_validate('[{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]')
t7 = TC_.from_dict_list([{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}])
assert t1 == t2 == t3 == t5 == t7
assert [tc.name for tc in t4.tool_calls] == ["foo", "bar"]
assert [tc.name for tc in t6.tool_calls] == ["foo"]
# tool_calls as single inner dict
t8 = TC_.model_validate({"tool_calls": {"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}})
assert t8 == t3
# ToolCall instances pass through TypeAdapter too
ta = TypeAdapter(TC_)
assert ta.validate_python({"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}) == t3
assert ta.validate_python({"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}) == t3

# --- Task 2: fingerprints ---
c1 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"a": 1, "b": " x "})
c2 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"b": "x", "a": 1})
c3 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"b": "  x  ", "a": 1})
assert c1.fingerprint == c2.fingerprint == c3.fingerprint
assert len(c1.fingerprint) == 64
assert all(ch in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in c1.fingerprint)
assert c1.id == c1.fingerprint[:8]
assert len(c1.id) == 8

# tuple -> list
c4 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"t": (1, 2)})
c5 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"t": [1, 2]})
assert c4.fingerprint == c5.fingerprint

# name matters
c6 = TC_.ToolCall(name="bar", args={"a": 1, "b": " x "})
assert c6.fingerprint != c1.fingerprint

# different args matter
c7 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"a": 2})
assert c7.fingerprint != c2.fingerprint

# booleans/numbers preserved (True vs 1 must differ)
c8 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"a": True})
c9 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"a": 1})
assert c8.fingerprint != c9.fingerprint

# nested sorting + trimming
c10 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"n": {"y": " z ", "x": [1, (2, 3)]}})
c11 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"n": {"x": [1, [2, 3]], "y": "z"}})
assert c10.fingerprint == c11.fingerprint

# empty args
c12 = TC_.ToolCall(name="get_time", args={})
assert len(c12.fingerprint) == 64 and c12.id == c12.fingerprint[:8]

# format() unaffected
assert t3.format() == [{"type": "tool_calls", "tool_calls": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "foo", "arguments": {"a": 1}}}}]}

# fingerprint stable across model_validate / from_dict_list
c13 = TypeAdapter(TC_.ToolCall).validate_python({"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1, "b": " x "}})
assert c13.fingerprint == c1.fingerprint

# equality still works
assert TC_(tool_calls=[TC_.ToolCall(name="get_weather", args={"city": "Paris"})]) == TC_.from_dict_list([{"name": "get_weather", "args": {"city": "Paris"}}])

# instance pass-through
assert TC_.validate_input(t3) == t3
assert TC_.model_validate(t3) == t3

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
print("sample fingerprint:", c1.fingerprint, c1.id)
EOF

t6 = TC_.model_validate('[{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]')

assert t8 == t3
# ToolCall instances pass through TypeAdapter too

# --- Task 2: fingerprints ---
c1 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"a": 1, "b": " x "})
c2 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"b": "x", "a": 1})
c3 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"b": "  x  ", "a": 1})
assert c1.fingerprint == c2.fingerprint == c3.fingerprint
assert len(c1.fingerprint) == 64
assert all(ch in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in c1.fingerprint)
assert c1.id == c1.fingerprint[:8]
assert len(c1.id) == 8

# tuple -> list
c4 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"t": (1, 2)})
c5 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"t": [1, 2]})
assert c4.fingerprint == c5.fingerprint

# name matters
c6 = TC_.ToolCall(name="bar", args={"a": 1, "b": " x "})
assert c6.fingerprint != c1.fingerprint

# different args matter

c8 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"a": True})
c9 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"a": 1})

c10 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"n": {"y": " z ", "x": [1, (2, 3)]}})
c11 = TC_.ToolCall(name="foo", args={"n": {"x": [1, [2, 3]], "y": "z"}})

# empty args
c12 = TC_.ToolCall(name="get_time", args={})

        "type": "tool_calls",
        "tool_calls": [
            {
                "type": "function",
                "function": {
                    "name": "foo",
                    "arguments": {"a": 1},

# Simulate the adapter parse path: parse_value with ToolCalls annotation
from dspy.adapters.utils import parse_value
from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

# canonical dict value
v1 = parse_value({"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}, ToolCalls)
# single-object value
v2 = parse_value({"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}, ToolCalls)
# bare list value
v3 = parse_value([{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}, {"name": "bar", "args": {}}], ToolCalls)
# JSON string values
v4 = parse_value('{"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}', ToolCalls)
v5 = parse_value('{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}', ToolCalls)
v6 = parse_value('[{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]', ToolCalls)

assert v1 == v2 == v4 == v5
assert isinstance(v1, ToolCalls)
assert v1.tool_calls[0].name == "foo"
assert v1.tool_calls[0].args == {"a": 1}
assert v3 == ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}, {"name": "bar", "args": {}}])
assert len(v6.tool_calls) == 1

# fingerprints present on all
for v in (v1, v2, v3, v6):
    for tc in v.tool_calls:
        assert len(tc.fingerprint) == 64 and tc.id == tc.fingerprint[:8]

import dspy
class MySignature(dspy.Signature):
    question: str = dspy.InputField()
    tool_calls: dspy.ToolCalls = dspy.OutputField()

adapter = dspy.JSONAdapter(use_native_function_calling=False)

import litellm
from unittest import mock
def fake_completion(*args, **kwargs):

res = adapter.parse(MySignature, '{"tool_calls": {"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}}')
assert res["tool_calls"] == v2
res = adapter.parse(MySignature, '{"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}')
assert res["tool_calls"] == v2
res = adapter.parse(MySignature, '{"tool_calls": {"tool_calls": [{"name": "foo", "args": {"a": 1}}]}}')
